name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.2): a statement on any cash account now opens on Reconciliation Statements (CA302000), with a tick and an untick proven on build 24.111 and 2026R1, one row at a time; 0.81.1 reached only the page's default account. A statement that does not exist is refused. whoami no longer blames the tenant on a site that does not serve DAC-based OData: it reports tenant_ok true and dac_odata false. The classic page tools no longer need OData to find their page. 0.81.1 made aspx_grid_batch able to tick a row and stopped a grid warning reading as a failed save. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
